Rank 21 - Agriculture

Fish Farm Feed and Harvest Ledger

Fish farmers need pond cost, feed, medicine, mortality, harvest, and buyer records.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 6,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 300Recommended monthly charge

BDT 300/month is possible if sold through feed shops or local agents with group onboarding.

7.1Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 6,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 300Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 9,600,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Fisheries statistics point to millions of fish farmers and fishers. Start with commercial pond owners and feed sellers who advise farmers.

Farmers often do not know true pond profit after feed, medicine, labor, and buyer dues.

Know actual pond profit, not just sale amount.

Validation signals

  • Fish farmer base is large.
  • Feed cost is major expense.
  • Profit calculation is practical.
  • Feed shops can become distribution partners.

MVP modules

  • Pond profile
  • Fingerling entry
  • Feed log
  • Medicine log
  • Mortality note
  • Harvest sale
  • Profit report

Do not build first

  • Do not build AI disease diagnosis first.
  • Do not sell financial loans.
  • Do not require constant internet.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Partner with one feed shop.
  • Onboard 20 pond owners.
  • Track one production cycle.
  • Add advisory later.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Low digital literacy.
  • Seasonal cycles.
  • Rural support cost.
Mitigations
  • Agent-assisted entry.
  • Cycle-based reports.
  • Offline-first app.
